correctness.rationale: For signed weights of total mass one, the equilateral zero-mass KR norm is precisely half the total variation. Renormalizing positive weights strictly decreases every point-distance when any negative weight is present. The minimizing nonnegative weights are the unique saturation of the inequalities w_i >= (1-zr_i)_+, yielding the explicit maximum over sorted prefixes. The floor-one phase, relative interior, and signed-optimizer iff max radius >1 are then proved using strict slack. Independent subset-potential LP matches the exact result on 60 rational profiles; finite checks do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: This natural full class of asymmetric cone attachments to equilateral metric spaces has an explicit O(n log n) optimal extension formula for all dimensions and admissible radius vectors. The results include a sharp prefix-sum criterion for norm-one extension, rigidity at and above the threshold, a full-dimensional optimum face below it, and exact signed-coefficient emergence. These equality properties are not parameter substitution from the earlier equal-radius star value, and can inform concrete random-projection selection.
